<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 1: ENVIRONMENT SETUP
==============================================================================
Purpose: Generate publication-quality figures for manuscript
Dependencies: Seurat, ggplot2, cowplot, pheatmap, viridis
============================================================================== -->

```{r}
# Load Seurat for single-cell analysis
library(Seurat)
```

<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 2: LOAD DATA
==============================================================================
Load CMO dataset version 4 (final annotated version)
============================================================================== -->

```{r}
# Load CMO Seurat object
obj <- readRDS("~/PhD_Projects/CMO/cmo_version4.rds")
```

<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 3: HOX GENE ANALYSIS
==============================================================================
Extract Hox gene families for visualization
Hox genes are key regulators of anterior-posterior patterning
============================================================================== -->

```{r}
# Define Hox gene families by cluster
hox_genes <- list()
hox_genes$hoxa_genes <- grep("^Hoxa", rownames(obj), value = TRUE)  # Hoxa cluster
hox_genes$hoxb_genes <- grep("^Hoxb", rownames(obj), value = TRUE)  # Hoxb cluster
hox_genes$hoxc_genes <- grep("^Hoxc", rownames(obj), value = TRUE)  # Hoxc cluster
hox_genes$hoxd_genes <- grep("^Hoxd", rownames(obj), value = TRUE)  # Hoxd cluster
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 4: HOX DOTPLOT VISUALIZATION
==============================================================================
DotPlot: Show expression of all Hox genes across cell types
Horizontal lines highlight specific cell type boundaries
============================================================================== -->

```{r,fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
# Create DotPlot for individual Hox genes
hox_pl_a <- DotPlot(obj, features = hox_genes, scale.by = "size") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 15)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(7.5, 9.5), color = "red") +  # Highlight boundaries
  xlab("") + ylab("")
hox_pl_a
```

```{r}
# Create DotPlot for Hox module scores
# score_hoxa/b/c/d: Pre-computed module scores from AddModuleScore()
hox_pl_b <- DotPlot(obj, features = c("score_hoxa", "score_hoxb", "score_hoxc", "score_hoxd")) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 15)) +
  xlab("") + ylab("") + NoLegend()
hox_pl_b
```

```{r}
library(cowplot)
```

<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 5: COMBINE HOX PLOTS
==============================================================================
Use cowplot::plot_grid() to combine module scores and individual genes
============================================================================== -->

```{r,fig.width=20, fig.height=5}
# Combine plots with relative widths (scores = 4, individual genes = 16)
hox_pl_ab <- plot_grid(hox_pl_b, hox_pl_a, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(4, 16))
hox_pl_ab
```

<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 6: EXPORT HOX FIGURES
==============================================================================
Save as PNG (600 DPI) and PDF for publication
============================================================================== -->

```{r}
# Export as PNG (high resolution)
png(filename = "~/PhD_Projects/CMO/Bioinformatic_Analysis/step_16_figures/hox_dotplots.png",
    width = 20, height = 5, units = "in", res = 600)
hox_pl_ab
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Export as PDF (vector format)
pdf("~/PhD_Projects/CMO/Bioinformatic_Analysis/step_16_figures/hox_dotplots.pdf",
    width = 20, height = 5)
hox_pl_ab
dev.off()
```

<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 7: MARKER GENE HEATMAP
==============================================================================
Define key marker genes for cell type identification:
- Pluripotency: Zfp42, Pim2
- Primitive streak/mesoderm: T, Tacstd2, Dnd1, Sox17, Eomes
- Hox patterning: Hoxb2, Hoxa9
- Interferon response: Ifit1
- Hematopoietic: Tal1, Hba-x, Ptprc
- Endothelial: Vwf, Cdh5
- KO target genes: Atf3, Jdp2, Fos, Fosb, Fosl1, Fosl2, Batf, Batf3
- Zfp711 family: Zfp711, Zfx, Zfy1, Zfy2
- Bcl6b family: Bcl6b, Bcl6
============================================================================== -->

```{r}
# Define marker gene list organized by biological function
genes <- c("Zfp42", 'Pim2', "T", 'Tacstd2', 'Dnd1', 'Sox17', "Eomes", "Hoxb2", "Hoxa9", 
           "Ifit1", "Tal1", 'Hba-x', "Vwf", "Cdh5", "Ptprc",
           "Atf3", "Jdp2", "Fos", "Fosl1", "Fosb", "Fosl2", "Batf", "Batf3",
           "Zfp711", "Zfx", "Zfy1", "Zfy2",
           "Bcl6b", "Bcl6")
```

```{r}
library(Matrix)
library(pheatmap)
```

<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 8: COMPUTE AVERAGE EXPRESSION
==============================================================================
AverageExpression(): Calculate mean expression per cluster
============================================================================== -->

```{r}
# Calculate average expression per cluster
avg_genes <- AverageExpression(obj, features = genes, group.by = 'new_clusters')
```

```{r}
# Convert to dense matrix for pheatmap
dense_matrix_genes <- as.matrix(avg_genes$RNA)
```

```{r}
head(dense_matrix_genes)
```

```{r}
library(viridisLite)
library(viridis)
```

```{r}
# Transpose for cluster rows x gene columns layout
dense_matrix_genes <- t(dense_matrix_genes)
```

<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 9: PHEATMAP VISUALIZATION
==============================================================================
Create heatmap with:
- Column scaling (z-score per gene)
- No clustering (preserve annotation order)
- Viridis color palette
============================================================================== -->

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
pheatmap(
  dense_matrix_genes,
  scale = "column",                        # Z-score per gene (column)
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",  # Distance metric
  cluster_rows = FALSE,                    # Preserve cluster order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,                    # Preserve gene order
  show_rownames = TRUE,                    # Display cluster names
  show_colnames = TRUE,                    # Display gene names
  fontsize_row = 10,                       # Row label font size
  fontsize_col = 10,                       # Column label font size
  color = viridis(100),                    # Viridis color palette
  border_color = "lightgrey",              # Cell border color
  cellwidth = 18,                          # Cell width (pixels)
  cellheight = 18,                         # Cell height (pixels)
)
```

<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 12: UMAP CLUSTER VISUALIZATION
==============================================================================
Create publication-ready UMAP plots with cluster labels
============================================================================== -->

```{r}
# UMAP with cluster labels and legend
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "UMAP", label = T, cols = r3dcol$cols_46, 
        group.by = 'new_clusters', label.color = "black", pt.size = 0.5, label.size = 6.5) +
  NoAxes() +
  theme(legend.direction = "vertical", legend.position = "bottom") + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 8), ncol = 3))
```

```{r}
# Export cluster UMAP as PNG
png(filename = "./fig_clusters_umap_legend.png", width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 600)
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "UMAP", label = T, cols = r3dcol$cols_46, 
        group.by = 'new_clusters', label.color = "black", pt.size = 0.5, label.size = 6.5) +
  NoAxes() +
  theme(legend.direction = "vertical", legend.position = "bottom") + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 8), ncol = 3))
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Export cluster UMAP as PDF
pdf("./fig_clusters_umap_legend.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "UMAP", label = T, cols = r3dcol$cols_46, 
        group.by = 'new_clusters', label.color = "black", pt.size = 0.5, label.size = 6.5) +
  NoAxes() +
  theme(legend.direction = "vertical", legend.position = "bottom") + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 8), ncol = 3))
dev.off()
```

<!-- ==============================================================================
SECTION 14: COMPREHENSIVE MARKER DOTPLOT
==============================================================================
DotPlot with colored rectangles highlighting lineage-specific marker regions:
- Green: Mesoderm markers (genes 14-20, clusters 12-17)
- Yellow: Lateral plate/limb mesoderm (genes 21-27, clusters 18-23)
- Red: Erythroid markers (genes 29-33, clusters 25-29)
- Blue: Endothelial markers (genes 34-36, clusters 30-32)
- Orange: HEP/Blood progenitor (genes 37-41, clusters 33-36)
- Purple: Immune/Endothelial (genes 42-46, clusters 37-40)
- Light grey: Pluripotency (genes 4-7, clusters 4-6)
- Dark grey: Primitive streak (genes 10-12, clusters 9-10)
============================================================================== -->

```{r,fig.width=13, fig.height=10}
# Create annotated DotPlot with lineage-specific highlighting
fig_xxx1 <-
  DotPlot(obj, features = c("Zfp42", "Pim2", "T", "Tacstd2", "Sfn", "Cldn3", "Anxa1", "Dnd1", 
                            "Mesp1", "Sox17", "Fgf5", "Ttr", "Mixl1", "Hoxb2", "Fgf15", "Cacna1d",
                            "Nrxn3", "Stard8", "Upk3b", "Plxna4", "Hoxa9", "Greb1", "Dach1", "Actc1", 
                            "Igfbp7", "Wnt2", "Fgf12",
                            "Ifit1", "Tal1", "Gypa", "Hba-a1", "Hba-a2", "Alas2", "Plek", "Fermt3", 
                            "Vwf", "Icam2", "Gadd45g", "Cdh5",
                            "Cyp26b1", "Rsad2", "Ptprc", "Nrg1", "Il17ra", "Ccl4", "Sepp1"), 
          group.by = "new_subclusters") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 15)) +  
  # Lineage-specific highlighting rectangles
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 14 - 0.5, xmax = 20 + 0.5, ymin = 12 - 0.5, ymax = 17 + 0.5), 
            fill = "transparent", color = "green", size = 0.5) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 21 - 0.5, xmax = 27 + 0.5, ymin = 18 - 0.5, ymax = 23 + 0.5), 
            fill = "transparent", color = "yellow", size = 0.5) +  
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 29 - 0.5, xmax = 33 + 0.5, ymin = 25 - 0.5, ymax = 29 + 0.5), 
            fill = "transparent", color = "red", size = 0.5) +  
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 34 - 0.5, xmax = 36 + 0.5, ymin = 30 - 0.5, ymax = 32 + 0.5), 
            fill = "transparent", color = "blue", size = 0.5) +  
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 37 - 0.5, xmax = 41 + 0.5, ymin = 33 - 0.5, ymax = 36 + 0.5), 
            fill = "transparent", color = "orange", size = 0.5) +  
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 42 - 0.5, xmax = 46 + 0.5, ymin = 37 - 0.5, ymax = 40 + 0.5), 
            fill = "transparent", color = "purple", size = 0.5) +  
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 4 - 0.5, xmax = 7 + 0.5, ymin = 4 - 0.5, ymax = 6 + 0.5), 
            fill = "transparent", color = "lightgrey", size = 0.5) +  
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 10 - 0.5, xmax = 12 + 0.5, ymin = 9 - 0.5, ymax = 10 + 0.5), 
            fill = "transparent", color = "darkgrey", size = 0.5) +
  xlab("") + ylab("") + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

fig_xxx1
```
